gloss: first time, first round, first inning

definitions.gloss: first time, first round, first inning
definitions.explanation: The first occurrence or round of something in a series. Commonly used for the first episode, first session, or first inning in sports.

examples.japanese: {初回|しょかい}{限定|げんてい}の{特典|とくてん}がつく。
examples.english: It comes with a first-edition bonus.

examples.japanese: {初回|しょかい}は{無料|むりょう}で{体験|たいけん}できます。
examples.english: The first session is free to try.

examples.japanese: ピッチャーは{初回|しょかい}から3{点|てん}を{失|うしな}い、{苦|くる}しい{展開|てんかい}になった。
examples.english: The pitcher gave up 3 runs in the first inning, making it a difficult game.

notes:
Used both as a standalone noun and as a modifier with の. In baseball, {初回|しょかい} specifically refers to the first inning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{初回|しょかい}{限定|げんてい} (first-edition limited)
・{初回|しょかい}{無料|むりょう} (first time free)
・{初回|しょかい}{放送|ほうそう} (first broadcast/premiere)
・{初回|しょかい}から (from the very first time)
